# Présentation de la FBB

![Image 3](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/border_brush_top_white_fill.svg)

La FBB

Présentation de la FBB

## Qui sommes-nous

La Fondation Brigitte Bardot (FBB) fondée par Brigitte Bardot en 1986, est une ONG française dont la mission est la protection des animaux sauvages et domestiques.

Reconnue d’utilité publique depuis le 21 février 1992, son champ d’action est national et international, la FBB intervient dans 70 pays.

Aujourd’hui, elle compte plus de 70 000 donateurs répartis dans le monde entier, près de 300 salariés et plus de 500 enquêteurs et délégués bénévoles.

## Brigitte Bardot, le combat d’une vie

_«J’ai donné ma jeunesse et ma beauté aux hommes, je donne ma sagesse et mon expérience aux animaux.»_ Brigitte Bardot

[Découvrez l’histoire de la FBB](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/notre-histoire/)

![Image 4](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/GettyImages-2098895574-1.jpg)

![Image 6](blob:http://localhost/16f59174e4724bb3eebddcb8642b0596)

## L’organisation de la FBB

Avec la création de sa Fondation en 1986, reconnue d’utilité publique en 1992, Brigitte Bardot s’est entourée d’une équipe lui permettant de mener son combat pour la cause animale, en France et partout dans le monde.

Chaque jour, les équipes réparties sur le terrain et au sein de nos différents services, travaillent avec passion et détermination pour mettre fin à la souffrance animale.

[En savoir plus](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/organisation-de-la-fbb/)

## Les missions de la FBB

![Image 8](blob:http://localhost/5fea5eb2c408fd10f1d422e4e67c2ee4)

## Lutter contre la souffrance animale

Chaque jour, nous mobilisons toutes nos forces pour venir en aide aux animaux en détresse. Nous combattons la souffrance sous toutes ses formes, en luttant contre la maltraitance, les abandons et les violences qui leurs sont infligées.

Nous agissons aussi pour endiguer la prolifération de chats errants en France et en Outre-mer, en mettant en place des campagnes de stérilisation et des programmes de sauvetages.

Nous portons plainte et nous nous constituons partie civile à chaque fois que nous le pouvons pour faire entendre, haut et fort, la voix des animaux et faire condamner les auteurs.

![Image 10: Furet domestique en gros plan montrant son visage expressif avec ses yeux bleus brillants, son museau rose et sa fourrure beige claire, photographié sur fond vert sombre flou](blob:http://localhost/e450b3ec0f965d6474055998a8490f9c)

![Image 12: Furet domestique en gros plan montrant son visage expressif avec ses yeux bleus brillants, son museau rose et sa fourrure beige claire, photographié sur fond vert sombre flou](blob:http://localhost/e450b3ec0f965d6474055998a8490f9c)

## Agir en France et à l’international

Nous travaillons sur le renforcement des réglementations en interpellant les différents gouvernements, les politiques, les entreprises et la société civile au niveau local, national et international.

Nous soutenons des associations en France et partout dans le monde pour les encourager à poursuivre leurs actions.

La Fondation Brigitte Bardot participe également à des congrès internationaux majeurs tels que la CITES (Convention sur le commerce international des espèces menacées) ou la SSN (Species Survival Network), le but étant de jouer un rôle clé dans la discussion et l’adoption de lois visant à protéger les espèces animales.

[Découvrir nos actions à l’International](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/nos-actions-a-linternational/)

## Éveiller la conscience collective

Nous prenons à cœur notre rôle éducatif et pédagogique pour que les jeunes générations comprennent ce qu’est le respect de l’animal. Nous devons faire évoluer les mentalités en expliquant et en sensibilisant sur la nécessité et l’importance de la protection animale.

Nos actions se déploient à travers des campagnes de sensibilisation, des programmes d’information et des supports adaptés qui permettent de transmettre les valeurs de la compassion et du respect envers tous les êtres vivants.

![Image 14: Furet domestique en gros plan montrant son visage expressif avec ses yeux bleus brillants, son museau rose et sa fourrure beige claire, photographié sur fond vert sombre flou](blob:http://localhost/e450b3ec0f965d6474055998a8490f9c)

## Toutes les actions de la FBB sont guidées par le respect, l'engagement et le courage pour les mener avec détermination

[Découvrir nos actions](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/nos-actions/)

## Les avancées de la FBB

La Fondation Brigitte Bardot a été à l’avant-garde de nombreuses initiatives visant à protéger et à améliorer les conditions de vie des animaux. Découvrez les victoires majeures obtenues grâce à l’engagement indéfectible de Brigitte Bardot et de sa Fondation.

[Découvrez nos avancées](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/les-avancees-de-la-fbb/)

![Image 16: Furet domestique en gros plan montrant son visage expressif avec ses yeux bleus brillants, son museau rose et sa fourrure beige claire, photographié sur fond vert sombre flou](blob:http://localhost/e450b3ec0f965d6474055998a8490f9c)

Gérer le consentement

Pour offrir les meilleures expériences, nous utilisons des technologies telles que les cookies pour stocker et/ou accéder aux informations des appareils. Le fait de consentir à ces technologies nous permettra de traiter des données telles que le comportement de navigation ou les ID uniques sur ce site. Le fait de ne pas consentir ou de retirer son consentement peut avoir un effet négatif sur certaines caractéristiques et fonctions.

Fonctionnel- [x] Fonctionnel  Toujours activé 

L’accès ou le stockage technique est strictement nécessaire dans la finalité d’intérêt légitime de permettre l’utilisation d’un service spécifique explicitement demandé par l’abonné ou l’utilisateur, ou dans le seul but d’effectuer la transmission d’une communication sur un réseau de communications électroniques.

Préférences- [x] Préférences 

L’accès ou le stockage technique est nécessaire dans la finalité d’intérêt légitime de stocker des préférences qui ne sont pas demandées par l’abonné ou l’internaute.

Statistiques- [x] Statistiques 

Le stockage ou l’accès technique qui est utilisé exclusivement à des fins statistiques.Le stockage ou l’accès technique qui est utilisé exclusivement dans des finalités statistiques anonymes. Marketing- [x] Marketing 

L’accès ou le stockage technique est nécessaire pour créer des profils d’internautes afin d’envoyer des publicités, ou pour suivre l’utilisateur sur un site web ou sur plusieurs sites web ayant des finalités marketing similaires.

# Décès de notre Fondatrice et Présidente, Madame Brigitte Bardot

![Image 3](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Banniere-site.jpg)

### Décès de notre Fondatrice et Présidente, Madame Brigitte Bardot

La Fondation Brigitte Bardot annonce avec une immense tristesse, le décès de sa Fondatrice et Présidente, Madame Brigitte Bardot, actrice et chanteuse mondialement reconnue, qui a choisi d’abandonner sa carrière prestigieuse pour dédier sa vie et son énergie à la défense des animaux et à sa Fondation.

En 1962, alors qu’elle n’a que 28 ans, Brigitte Bardot marque les esprits en participant à l’émission emblématique « 5 colonnes à la une » pour exiger l’étourdissement des animaux avant leur abattage, montrant ainsi son engagement précoce.  
Véritable précurseur, elle renonce à 39 ans aux feux de la rampe et au monde artistique pour mettre sa notoriété et toute sa détermination au service des animaux et des êtres les plus faibles, comme les personnes âgées.  
Elle se rend sur la banquise en 1977 afin de venir en aide aux bébés phoques, acte emblématique de son combat pour la protection des espèces vulnérables.  
Sous son impulsion, la Fondation Brigitte Bardot, créée en 1986, devient un acteur majeur de la protection animale en France et dans le Monde entier. Quarante ans après, elle compte plus de12.000 animaux recueillis dans l’«Arche de BB», des actions dans 70 pays, 4 refuges, 300 salariés, des centaines de bénévoles et 40.000 donateurs.  
En interpellant fréquemment les politiques pour faire avancer les législations, en faisant condamner les auteurs de maltraitances, en réalisant chaque jour des sauvetages, en sensibilisant un large public, la Fondation est à son tour considérée comme une référence mondiale dont Brigitte Bardot a veillé à assurer la pérennité.  
La Fondation Brigitte Bardot tient à saluer la mémoire d’une femme exceptionnelle qui a tout donné et tout abandonné pour un monde plus respectueux des animaux. Son héritage demeure vivant à travers les actions et les combats que la Fondation poursuit avec la même passion et la même fidélité à ses idéaux.  
Nous adressons nos sincères condoléances à sa famille, à ses proches, à la municipalité de Saint-Tropez et aux Tropéziens, et à tous ceux qui partagent ce combat.  
La Fondation continuera, plus que jamais, à porter l’œuvre de Brigitte Bardot.

Nos animaliers au sein de nos refuges de [Bazoches](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/refuge-de-bazoches/), [La Mare Auzou](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/refuge-de-la-mare-auzou/), [La Davière](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/refuge-de-la-daviere/) et [Montpon](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/refuge-de-montpon/) ont voulu rendre eux-aussi hommage à Brigitte Bardot. Présents tous les jours auprès des animaux, ils incarnent la combat de Brigitte au quotidien.

Entourés des animaux qu’elle a toujours défendus, les animaliers de nos refuges disent merci à Brigitte : « Son combat vit en nous, et nous le poursuivrons sans relâche, pour eux, pour elle, pour toujours… Reposez-vous maintenant, on prend le relais… »

Découvrez leur hommage en vidéo.

# Présentation de la FBB

![Image 3](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/border_brush_top_white_fill.svg)

La FBB

Présentation de la FBB

## Qui sommes-nous

La Fondation Brigitte Bardot (FBB) fondée par Brigitte Bardot en 1986, est une ONG française dont la mission est la protection des animaux sauvages et domestiques.

Reconnue d’utilité publique depuis le 21 février 1992, son champ d’action est national et international, la FBB intervient dans 70 pays.

Aujourd’hui, elle compte plus de 70 000 donateurs répartis dans le monde entier, près de 300 salariés et plus de 500 enquêteurs et délégués bénévoles.

## Brigitte Bardot, le combat d’une vie

_«J’ai donné ma jeunesse et ma beauté aux hommes, je donne ma sagesse et mon expérience aux animaux.»_ Brigitte Bardot

[Découvrez l’histoire de la FBB](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/notre-histoire/)

![Image 4](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/GettyImages-2098895574-1.jpg)

![Image 6](blob:http://localhost/16f59174e4724bb3eebddcb8642b0596)

## L’organisation de la FBB

Avec la création de sa Fondation en 1986, reconnue d’utilité publique en 1992, Brigitte Bardot s’est entourée d’une équipe lui permettant de mener son combat pour la cause animale, en France et partout dans le monde.

Chaque jour, les équipes réparties sur le terrain et au sein de nos différents services, travaillent avec passion et détermination pour mettre fin à la souffrance animale.

[En savoir plus](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/organisation-de-la-fbb/)

## Les missions de la FBB

![Image 8](blob:http://localhost/5fea5eb2c408fd10f1d422e4e67c2ee4)

## Lutter contre la souffrance animale

Chaque jour, nous mobilisons toutes nos forces pour venir en aide aux animaux en détresse. Nous combattons la souffrance sous toutes ses formes, en luttant contre la maltraitance, les abandons et les violences qui leurs sont infligées.

Nous agissons aussi pour endiguer la prolifération de chats errants en France et en Outre-mer, en mettant en place des campagnes de stérilisation et des programmes de sauvetages.

Nous portons plainte et nous nous constituons partie civile à chaque fois que nous le pouvons pour faire entendre, haut et fort, la voix des animaux et faire condamner les auteurs.

![Image 10: Furet domestique en gros plan montrant son visage expressif avec ses yeux bleus brillants, son museau rose et sa fourrure beige claire, photographié sur fond vert sombre flou](blob:http://localhost/e450b3ec0f965d6474055998a8490f9c)

![Image 12: Furet domestique en gros plan montrant son visage expressif avec ses yeux bleus brillants, son museau rose et sa fourrure beige claire, photographié sur fond vert sombre flou](blob:http://localhost/e450b3ec0f965d6474055998a8490f9c)

## Agir en France et à l’international

Nous travaillons sur le renforcement des réglementations en interpellant les différents gouvernements, les politiques, les entreprises et la société civile au niveau local, national et international.

Nous soutenons des associations en France et partout dans le monde pour les encourager à poursuivre leurs actions.

La Fondation Brigitte Bardot participe également à des congrès internationaux majeurs tels que la CITES (Convention sur le commerce international des espèces menacées) ou la SSN (Species Survival Network), le but étant de jouer un rôle clé dans la discussion et l’adoption de lois visant à protéger les espèces animales.

[Découvrir nos actions à l’International](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/nos-actions-a-linternational/)

## Éveiller la conscience collective

Nous prenons à cœur notre rôle éducatif et pédagogique pour que les jeunes générations comprennent ce qu’est le respect de l’animal. Nous devons faire évoluer les mentalités en expliquant et en sensibilisant sur la nécessité et l’importance de la protection animale.

Nos actions se déploient à travers des campagnes de sensibilisation, des programmes d’information et des supports adaptés qui permettent de transmettre les valeurs de la compassion et du respect envers tous les êtres vivants.

![Image 14: Furet domestique en gros plan montrant son visage expressif avec ses yeux bleus brillants, son museau rose et sa fourrure beige claire, photographié sur fond vert sombre flou](blob:http://localhost/e450b3ec0f965d6474055998a8490f9c)

## Toutes les actions de la FBB sont guidées par le respect, l'engagement et le courage pour les mener avec détermination

## Les avancées de la FBB

La Fondation Brigitte Bardot a été à l’avant-garde de nombreuses initiatives visant à protéger et à améliorer les conditions de vie des animaux. Découvrez les victoires majeures obtenues grâce à l’engagement indéfectible de Brigitte Bardot et de sa Fondation.

## Isiah Whitlock Jr.

[![Image 11: Isiah Whitlock Jr. poses on the red carpet for "Devil In Disguise: John Wayne Gacy."](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/isiah-whitlock-jr-attends-peacocks-113168904.jpg?w=683)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Isiah Whitlock Jr. has died. He was 71 years old. Getty Images

“The Wire” actor Isiah Whitlock Jr. [has died](https://nypost.com/2025/12/30/entertainment/the-wire-actor-isiah-whitlock-jr-dead-at-71/) at age 71.

Whitlock’s manager, Brian Liebman, announced the sad news via Instagram on Dec. 30, penning: “It is with tremendous sadness that I share the passing of my dear friend and client Isiah Whitlock Jr. If you knew him — you loved him. A brilliant actor and even better person. May his memory forever be a blessing. Our hearts are so broken. He will be very, very missed.”

The actor was best known for roles in “The Wire,” “Veep,” “Your Honor” and “The Residence.”[](https://nypost.com/2025/12/30/entertainment/the-wire-actor-isiah-whitlock-jr-dead-at-71/#)

## Tatiana Schlossberg

[![Image 12: Tatiana Schlossberg speaking into a microphone.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/tatiana-schlossberg-attends-intelligencer-live-116139160_b51576.jpg?w=682)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Caroline Kennedy’s daughter Tatiana Schlossberg died after a battle with leukemia, her family announced on Dec. 30. Getty Images for New York Magazine

Caroline Kennedy’s daughter Tatiana Schlossberg [died after a battle with acute myeloid leukemia](https://pagesix.com/2025/12/30/celebrity-news/caroline-kennedys-daughter-tatiana-schlossberg-dead-at-35-after-battle-with-leukemia/), her family announced on Dec. 30.

She was 35 years old.

“Our beautiful Tatiana passed away this morning,” the JFK Library Foundation, on behalf of Schlossberg’s extended family, announced[via Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DS5cxd6E2p_/). “She will always be in our hearts.”

The message was signed by her family, “George, Edwin and Josephine Moran Ed, Caroline, Jack, Rose and Rory.”

Schlossberg — who shared her diagnosis in an essay for the New Yorker, published in November — was initially diagnosed in May 2024 and had been given just a year to live.

She was married to George Moran and the two shared a 3-year-old son and a 1-year-old daughter.

## Melanie Watson Bernhardt

[![Image 13: Melanie Watson as Kathy Gordon in a wheelchair and Gary Coleman as Arnold Jackson on the floor in "Diff'rent Strokes."](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/l-r-melanie-watson-kathy-117967197.jpg)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Melanie Watson Bernhardt died at the age of 57. NBCUniversal via Getty Images

Melanie Watson Bernhardt, best known for playing the character Kathy Gordon on”Diff’rent Strokes,” [died Dec. 26](https://pagesix.com/2025/12/28/entertainment/actress-from-beloved-80s-sitcom-diffrent-strokes-dies-at-age-57/). She was 57.

The actress, who battled the genetic disorder osteogenesis imperfecta — which causes bones to break easily, poor muscle tone, hearing loss, and dental problems — had been hospitalized after suffering bleeding issues, the outlet reported.

Her health reportedly deteriorated quickly after she was hospitalized.

## Brigitte Bardot

[![Image 14: Publicity portrait of French actress Brigitte Bardot.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/publicity-portrait-french-actress-brigitte-117944078_d7c617.jpg)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Brigitte Bardot died on Dec. 28. Getty Images

Brigitte Bardot, the French actress who was named the original “sex kitten,”[has died](https://pagesix.com/2025/12/28/celebrity-news/brigitte-bardot-dead-at-91/), according to her foundation. She was 91.

“The Brigitte Bardot Foundation announces with immense sadness the death of its founder and president, Madame Brigitte Bardot, a world-renowned actress and singer, who chose to abandon her prestigious career to dedicate her life and energy to animal welfare and her foundation,” the foundation, which fights to protect animals,[announced on its website](https://www.fondationbrigittebardot.fr/deces-de-notre-fondatrice-et-presidente-madame-brigitte-bardot/)Dec. 28.

“The Brigitte Bardot Foundation wishes to honor the memory of an exceptional woman who gave everything for a world more respectful of animals,” it added.

## Mickey Lee

[![Image 15: Mickey Lee, a houseguest on Big Brother season 27, wearing a pink dress.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/mickey-lee-houseguest-season-27-117765520_195ff1.jpg?w=731)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

CBS via Getty Images

“Big Brother” Season 51 star Mickey Lee [died on Christmas Day](https://pagesix.com/2025/12/26/celebrity-news/big-brother-star-mickey-lee-dead-at-35-after-suffering-multiple-cardiac-arrests/) after [suffering multiple cardiac arrests](https://pagesix.com/2025/12/22/celebrity-news/big-brother-contestant-in-critical-condition-after-cardiac-arrests-long-and-challenging-road-ahead/). She was 35.

“Mickey’s light, legacy and impact will never be forgotten,” the reality star’s family members wrote in a lengthy social media statement on Dec. 26.

Earlier that same week, a GoFundMe page dedicated to Lee’s recovery revealed she was in “critical but stable condition” after the “sudden health crisis” with a “long and challenging … road ahead.”

## James Ronsone

[![Image 16: James Ransone, dressed in a black jacket and black pants, stands for a photo at Build Studio.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/james-ransone-discusses-chapter-2-117708022.jpg?w=683)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Getty Images

James Ransone, who played Ziggy on “The Wire,” [died by suicide](https://nypost.com/2025/12/21/entertainment/the-wire-actor-james-ransone-dies-by-suicide-at-46/) on Dec. 19 at age 46.

The late actor’s widow, Jamie McPhee, [mourned him in a touching Instagram statement](https://nypost.com/2025/12/22/entertainment/james-ransones-widow-breaks-silence-following-the-actors-suicide/) two days later.

“I told you I have loved you 1000 times before and I know I will love you again,” she wrote. “You told me – I need to be more like you and you need to be more like me – and you were so right. Thank you for giving me the greatest gifts – you, Jack and Violet. We are forever.”

The couple wed in 2017 and shared two children.

## **Greg Biffle and Cristina Grossu Biffle**

[![Image 17: NASCAR driver Greg Biffle poses with his family.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/nascar-driver-greg-biffle-poses-117554814.jpg)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Former NASCAR driver Greg Biffle, his wife, Cristina Grossu Biffle, and their two children have died in a plane crash. Instagram/Christina Biffle

Former NASCAR driver Greg Biffle and his wife, Cristina Grossu Biffle, died alongside their two children in a North Carolina plane crash on Dec. 18.

The family’s private jet was trying to land at Statesville Regional Airport around 10:15 a.m. when the accident happened.

The couple was with their 5-year-old son, Ryde, and Biffle’s daughter, Emma, 14, whom he shared with his ex-wife, Nicole Lunders.

Other victims included Dennis Dutton and his son Jack, and Craig Wadsworth.

## Anthony Geary

[![Image 18: Anthony Geary at the 2012 Disney ABC Television TCA summer press tour party.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/2012-disney-abc-television-tca-117394479.jpg?w=728)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

“General Hospital” legend Anthony Geary died on Dec. 14. He was 78 years old. WireImage

“General Hospital” legend Anthony Geary died on Dec. 14. He was 78 years old.

He passed away following complications from an operation three days prior,[TV Insider reported](https://www.tvinsider.com/1234092/anthony-geary-dead-general-hospital-luke-spencer/).

“It was a shock for me and our families and our friends,” Geary’s husband, Claudio Gama, told the outlet in a statement. “For more than 30 years, Tony has been my friend, my companion, my husband.”

He was best known for playing Luke Spencer in the soap opera and appeared in the series from 1978 to 2015.

## Rachael Carpani

[![Image 19: Rachael Carpani as Detective Lina Flores in "Against the Wall."](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/season-1-ep-110-117381433.jpg?w=681)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Australian actress Rachael Carpani died. She was 45 years old. ©Lifetime Television/Courtesy Everett Collection

Australian actress Rachael Carpani died. She was 45 years old.

On Dec. 15, her sister announced her death [via Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DSRZWzvk0SF/?hl=en), sharing that she had passed away following a chronic illness.

“It is with great sadness that Tony and Gael Carpani announce that their beautiful daughter, beloved Australian actress Rachael Carpani, unexpectedly but peacefully passed away after a long battle with chronic illness, in the early hours of Sunday 7th December,” the statement read.

“The family requests privacy at this very difficult time and will be making no further statements,” it concluded.

Carpani was best known for her role as Jodi Fountain in the Australian series“McLeod’s Daughters,”but also acted in“N.C.I.S: Los Angeles.”

## Carl Carlton

[![Image 20: Carl Carlton poses at Chene Park Amphitheater.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/photo-monica-morgan-wireimage-whispers-117394477.jpg?w=683)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

R&B singer Carl Carlton died. He was 72 years old. WireImage

Singer Carl Carlton, who is best known for his songs “She’s a Bad Mama Jama” and “Everlasting Love,” died. He was 72 years old.

On Dec. 14,Carlton’s son Carlton Hudgens II [announced on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/photo?fbid=10231267171530478&set=a.1307347171666)that his father, born Carlton Hudgens, had passed away.

“​​RIP Dad,Legend Carl Carlton, singer of ‘She’s a Bad Mama Jama,” he wrote alongside a photo of the late musician. “Long hard fight in life and you will be missed.”

## Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner

[![Image 21: Rob Reiner and Michele Reiner on a red carpet.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/GettyImages-72532914.jpg?w=651)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Rob Reiner and his wife, Michele Singer Reiner were killed in their home on Dec. 14. Getty Images

It was later confirmed to be the legendary director and his wife. The investigation is ongoing.

The couple tied the knot in 1989 and share three children: Jake, Nick and Romy.

[![Image 22: Peter Greene on the set of "Lowball."](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/12/peter-greene-seen-set-lowball-117259261.jpg?w=689)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Actor Peter Greene has died. He was 60 years old. Getty Images

Actor Peter Greene, who is best known for his roles in “Pulp Fiction” and “The Mask,” died. He was 60 years old.

[![Image 23: Comedian Jeff Garcia performing at The Ice House Comedy Club.](https://pagesix.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/11/comedian-voice-actor-jeff-garcia-117105615.jpg?w=819)135](https://pagesix.com/celebrity-news/celebrity-deaths-2025/# "Open a slideshow of all 135 article images.")

Family and friends confirmed Jeff Garcia had passed away on Dec. 10. WireImage

“French existence, universal brilliance. She touched us. We mourn a legend of the century,” he added.

Bardot was launched as an international sex symbol in 1956 when she starred as a sexualized teen bride in the movie “And God Created Woman.”

The film, which was directed by her then-husband, Roger Vadim, featured scenes of Bardot dancing on tables naked, marking a groundbreaking portrayal of female sexuality during a conservative time.

Title: 12K views · 290 reactions | FAREWELL, PEPPINO DI CAPRI
July 27, 1939 – July 11, 2026
Italian music has lost one of its most elegant and unmistakable voices.
Born Giuseppe Faiella on the island of Capri, Peppino Di Capri created a unique musical style by blending Neapolitan tradition with rock’n’roll, twist, jazz and romantic pop.
From the energy of “St. Tropez Twist” to the timeless emotion of “Champagne,” “Roberta,” “Nun è peccato” and “Un grande amore e niente più,” his songs became part of the soundtrack of several generations.
A refined pianist, singer and true innovator, Peppino also shared the stage with The Beatles during their historic 1965 Italian tour and won the Sanremo Music Festival twice.
His music will continue to echo beneath the lights of Capri and in the hearts of everyone who loved the golden age of Italian music.
Rest in peace, Maestro.
Thank you for the music, the elegance and the unforgettable memories.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Terms of honor in the Italian language

These are some of the honorifics used in Italy.

## Nobility

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Italian_honorifics&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Nobility")]

As part of the republican constitution that became effective in Italy on 1 January 1948, [titles](link_1) of [nobility](link_2) ceased to be recognized in law (although they were not, strictly, abolished or [banned](link_3)), and the [organ of state](link_4) which had regulated them, the _[Consulta Araldica](link_5)_, was abolished.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_honorifics#cite_note-1) However the so-called _predicati_— territorial or [manorial](link_6) designations that were often connected to a noble title by use of a [nobiliary particle](link_7) such as _di_, _da_, _della_, _dei_, could be resumed as part of the legal surname upon [judicial](link_8) approval for persons who possessed it prior to 28 October 1922 (date of [Italian fascism](link_9)'s accession to power).[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_honorifics#cite_note-regalis-2) In practice, this meant that, e.g., "John Doe, Duke of Somewhere" or "Princess Jane of Kingdom" might become "John Doe _di_ Somewhere" or "Jane _della_ Kingdom", respectively. Nonetheless, titles are often still used unofficially in villages, private clubs and some social sets. _Signore_ and _Signora_ (formerly signifying [landed nobility](link_10)) are translations of "Lord" and "Lady", used also in the military [hierarchy](link_11) and for persons in official positions or for members of a society's [elite](link_12). A few titles are also common in diminutive form as [terms of affection](link_13) for young people (e.g. _Principino_ for "Princeling" or _Contessina_ for "the Little Countess").

*   _Imperatore_ (Emperor) / _Imperatrice_ (Empress)
*   _Re_ (King) / _Regina_ (Queen)
*   _Principe_ (Prince) / _Principessa_ (Princess)
*   _Duca_ (Duke) / _Duchessa_ (Duchess)
*   _Marchese_ (Marquis) / _Marchesa_ (Marchioness)
*   _Conte_ (Count or Earl) / _Contessa_ (Countess)
*   _Visconte_ (Viscount) / _Viscontessa_ (Viscountess)
*   _Barone_ (Baron) / _Baronessa_ (Baroness)
*   _Patrizio_ ([Patrician](link_14)) / _Patrizia_
*   _Nobiluomo_ – n.h./n.u. (Nobleman) / _Nobildonna_ – n.d. (Noblewoman)
*   _Cavaliere Ereditario_ (Baronet) / no female equivalent[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_honorifics#cite_note-regalis-2)

Use of the prefix "Don" as a style for certain persons of distinction spread to the [Kingdom of Naples](link_15) and [Sicily](link_16) during the Spanish domination of southern Italy in the 16th century. Officially, it was the [style](link_17) to address a [noble](link_2) (as distinct from a [reigning](link_18)) prince (_principe_) or duke (_duca_), and their children and [agnatic](link_19) descendants. Any Italian monarch (as in Spain) might informally be addressed or referred to with this prefix, for example King [Carlos III of Spain](link_20) was widely known in his [Neapolitan](link_21) realm as "Don Carlo". [Genealogical](link_22) databases and [dynastic](link_23) works still reserve the title for this class of noble by tradition, although it is no longer a right under Italian law. In practice, especially in the countryside, _Don_ was also used as an honorific title for untitled noblemen, such as knights. The feminine is _Donna_.

## State honours

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Italian_honorifics&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: State honours")]

The President of the Republic can award "honours of the Republic". These are:

*   Medals (Gold, Silver, Bronze) to persons or entity for merit or valor
*   Knighthood (Cavaliere di Gran Croce, Grande Ufficiale, Commendatore – comm., Cavaliere Ufficiale – cav. uff., Cavaliere – cav.) of five Orders (Ordine al Merito della Repubblica Italiana, Ordine Militare d'Italia, Ordine al Merito del Lavoro, Ordine della Stella d'Italia, Ordine di Vittorio Veneto) 
    *   Ordine al Merito della Repubblica Italiana ([Order of Merit of the Italian Republic](link_24)) is for outstanding merit in regard to the nation
    *   Ordine Militare d'Italia ([Military Order of Italy](link_25)) rewards the actions of units of the armed forces or by individual soldiers, demonstrating expertise, responsibility and valour. The title may be given posthumously
    *   Ordine al Merito del Lavoro ([Order of Merit for Labour](link_26)) for those who have worked with skilfulness, contributing to the development of the nation and improving the status of the workers
    *   Ordine della Stella d'Italia ([Order of the Star of Italy](link_27)) for a contribution to the post-war reconstruction of Italy
    *   Ordine di Vittorio Veneto ([Order of Vittorio Veneto](link_28)) for Italian soldiers of the First World War

In addition, the Orders of Chivalry of the Royal [House of Savoy](link_29) and other Italian dynasties may confer honorifics (Cavaliere and Dama), as do the Holy See and the Order of Malta. Oddly, the Italian Republic bestows the rank of knight but not that of dame, though ladies may be decorated with knightly rank.

## State-related honorifics

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Italian_honorifics&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: State-related honorifics")]

*   _Presidente_ – pres. (President): used for the President of the Republic, or for the President of the Senate, of the Chamber of Deputies, of the Council of Ministers (Prime Minister), of the Constitutional Court, of a Region Council, for Judges president of a Court
*   _Presidente emerito_ – pres. em. (Emeritus President): used for former President of the Republic
*   _Senatore_ – sen. (Senator): some are for life (ex-Presidents of the Republic and persons who 'glorified' the Country)
*   _Onorevole_ - on. (Honourable): member of the Chamber of Deputies and member of the municipal Council of Rome.
*   _Ministro_ – min. (Minister)
*   _Giudice_ (Judge)
*   _Console_ – cons. (Consul)

## Work/profession-related titles

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Italian_honorifics&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Work/profession-related titles")]

*   Dottore / Dottoressa – dott. (Doctor; in Italy it is used for any person holding a university degree, even a [bachelor's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor [link_30]'s_degree "Bachelor's degree"). This often confuses foreigners.) 
    *   Dottore / Dottoressa magistrale - dott. mag. (Magistral Doctor; More specific title for people holding a _laurea magistrale_ the Italian equivalent to a [master degree](link_31))
    *   Dottore / Dottoressa di ricerca - dott. ric. ( Doctor of research; More specific title for people holding a _dottorato di ricerca_ the Italian equivalent to a [Doctorate](link_32), this title is the equivalent of the English [Doctor](link_33))

*   Maestro / Maestra ([teacher](link_34) or expert [artisan](link_35) or [musician](link_36)) 
    *   Mastro (archaic for artisans)

*   Professore – prof. / Professoressa – prof.ssa ([Professor](link_37), used for university professors, and, informally only, for high school teachers and university lecturers) 
    *   Full professors in the university are most formally addressed as _Chiarissimo Professor_ (Chiar.mo Prof.), derived from Latin _clarus_ which meant famed. University headmasters (Rettore) are formally addressed as _Magnifico Rettore_ (Magnificent Headmaster).

## Academic/professional qualification-related titles

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Italian_honorifics&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: Academic/professional qualification-related titles")]

*   High school diplomas: 
    *   Ragioniere – rag. (business economics).
    *   Geometra – geom. (land surveying and construction).
    *   Perito – per. (degree of technical extraction in a specific branch, such as chemistry or mechanics or naval or nautical; in some cases, however, a _perito_ holds no more than a three-year university _laurea_.)
    *   Maestro / Maestra (degree from a music conservatory or educational program). Note, however, that grade-school teachers of all levels are frequently called "_maestro_" in common, everyday use, while high-school teachers are called "_professore_").

*   University degrees: 
    *   Dottore – dott. (all people holding a [laurea](link_38) degree). The _laurea_ was previously the only academic degree given by Italian Universities. With the Riforma Universitaria, the Italian system has moved closer to conformity with the rest of Europe and North America. _Laurea_ may now refer to a three-year degree (the _laurea triennale_) or to a _laurea magistrale_, or master's degree, which requires two additional years of study. The former confers the title _dottore_; holders of the latter receive the academic title _dottore magistrale_.
    *   Avvocato – avv. (Lawyer, a [laurea specialistica](link_38) in law and a state-exam are both required.)
    *   Ingegnere – ing. (Engineer, a [laurea specialistica](link_38) in engineering and a state-exam are both required.)
    *   Arch

URL Source: https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https://muse.ai/&h=AUA47FAYk059t5fzCPFRxcKDnoGz1J8OH2Wgjmcwqp7eLeiKHW5YiDVpk40u8zK-WuB-7SeZxwWRi2qGo-nFNgG9fToaFFVSPFDMpKGXDroHeNpJ5t53MMQRdreXMC1yQPBCBuVkyt3CmA

Markdown Content:
Log in

![Image 1: Muse](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/brand/muse-logo.svg)
# Muse, AI that gets it done for you Muse[Video 1](https://l.facebook.com/videos/avatars/hatch_connecting.mp4)[Video 2](https://l.facebook.com/videos/avatars/hatch_working.mp4), AI that gets it done for you sorts your email books reservations shops for you saves you money manages calendars builds fitness plans gets it done for you sorts your email![Image 2](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-envelope.webp)books reservations![Image 3](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-airplane.webp)shops for you![Image 4](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-cart.webp)saves you money![Image 5](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-piggybank.webp)manages calendars![Image 6](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-calendar.webp)builds fitness plans![Image 7](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/b-01.webp)gets it done for you

# Log in or create an account

Mobile number or email(required) 

You may receive SMS notifications from us by using your mobile number. [Learn more](https://www.meta.com/help/artificial-intelligence/31983416211257755/)

Continue

[Learn more](https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https://muse.ai/&h=AUA47FAYk059t5fzCPFRxcKDnoGz1J8OH2Wgjmcwqp7eLeiKHW5YiDVpk40u8zK-WuB-7SeZxwWRi2qGo-nFNgG9fToaFFVSPFDMpKGXDroHeNpJ5t53MMQRdreXMC1yQPBCBuVkyt3CmA#landing-introduction-video-title)

## Built around your whole life

Give Muse a goal or task and it handles the rest, from saving money and improving your health to smart shopping and helping you strengthen your relationships.

[Video 3](https://scontent.xx.fbcdn.net/o1/v/t6/f2/m421/AQPvdntV2G814fVexG62mHy9MLAFz-IUx2_276pwlTOScjlG7403bT1NxrxgW2yToPZR5BOsHoRWgC3EQGGX.mp4?_nc_sid=9c7e41&_nc_ht=scontent.xx.fbcdn.net&ccb=17-1&_nc_gid=iRQoJgwC76_Toa75qvtN5w&edm=AIlawRcEAAAA&_nc_zt=28&oh=00_AQPdWfqDBYFzrXFseVn3LZFWtkFNRKw-z9pM9_ocuSlt9w&oe=6AE9AEEE#t=1)

### Every Muse user shares their own computer in the cloud with their Muse.

Muse Secure VM is a persistent, isolated Linux computer with a full browser that you and your agent can use to complete tasks, allowing you to intervene at any point. It's your computer and your browser, with the storage, CPU, and memory to handle real work.

![Image 8: Floating browser, search, map, calendar, and confirmation panels](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/browser.webp)![Image 9: Floating browser, search, map, calendar, and confirmation panels](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/browser-dark.webp)

### Designed around the way you already communicate

Chat with your agent in the same way you message with other people, using the Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp. There's no learning curve, just tell Muse what you want to get done.

![Image 10: A chat on a phone where the agent has filled out a school form, shown beside a laptop](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/messaging.webp)![Image 11: A chat on a phone where the agent has filled out a school form, shown beside a laptop](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/messaging-dark.webp)

### Stay in control of what your agent does

Approve actions your agent takes on your behalf before they happen, like sending emails and making purchases. See a complete audit trail of everything your agent has done (and what it's planning to do).

![Image 12: Floating purchase, message, activity, permission, and decision controls](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/approvals.webp)![Image 13: Floating purchase, message, activity, permission, and decision controls](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/approvals-dark.webp)

### Your data is kept secure and private

Save your logins to a secure credential store Muse can't see, with 1Password integration coming soon. When shopping, a one-time card number is generated at checkout so your real card stays hidden from the merchant and your agent. Eligible purchases are covered by [Link's purchase protections](https://link.com/protections), a first for AI agents, and your conversations are not shared with Meta's ad systems.

![Image 14: A vault, privacy shield, masked credential, security control, and virtual card](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/secure-storage.webp)![Image 15: A vault, privacy shield, masked credential, security control, and virtual card](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/secure-storage-dark.webp)

### Proactively helps with your goals and suggests ideas

Muse helps you stay on top of things, takes tasks and projects off your plate, and turns long-term goals into real progress. It learns from conversations, reflects on what matters and gets sharper, coming back with ideas built around what you actually need, ready to act on them under your direction.

![Image 16: Floating checklist, calendar, route, progress, and idea panels](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/goals.webp)![Image 17: Floating checklist, calendar, route, progress, and idea panels](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/goals-dark.webp)

### Connects to your apps and builds its own tools

Connect the apps you use daily, like email, calendar, and Instagram. You decide what your agent can see and what it can do. If a task needs a tool that doesn't exist, your agent builds it for you.

![Image 18: Connected app, messaging, media, cloud, calendar, and automation tiles](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/connectors.webp)

## Get the most out of your Muse

A guided tour of Muse, from setting a first goal to seeing it through.

![Image 19: Product designer presenting a guided tour of Muse](https://l.facebook.com/images/hatch/landing/product-walkthrough-cover.png)

## Learn more about Muse

Explore the choices behind Muse and how it is built to deserve your trust.

### [How We Designed Muse When Muse works, it feels like magic. These are the product choices that make the experience possible.](https://introducing.muse.ai/)### [How We Built Safety Into Muse Muse is built for privacy, safety, and security. Learn how these principles shape every part of the product.](https://security.muse.ai/)### [Muse for Business Meet the AI agent that works for your small business and keeps jobs moving between your decisions.](https://l.facebook.com/business)

## Ready to try Muse?

Log in

© Meta 2026

# Record album

 collection of music tracks 

*   [Tongue](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#p-lang "Tongue")
*   [Follow](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/w/index.php?title=Speciale:Entra&returnto=Album+discografico&_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en)
*   [Edit](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/w/index.php?title=Album_discografico&action=edit&_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en)

A **record album** , usually simply referred to as **an album** , is a collection of sound recordings (e.g., [music](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Musica?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Music") ) issued on a medium such as [compact disc](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Compact_disc?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Compact disc") , [vinyl record](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Disco_in_vinile?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Vinyl record") , [audio tape](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Nastro_audio?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Audio tape") (such as [Stereo8](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Stereo8?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Stereo8") or [audio cassette](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Audiocassetta?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Audio cassette") ), or digitally [.](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Distribuzione_digitale?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Digital distribution") Sound recording albums were developed in the early 20th century as individual [78 rpm](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/78_giri?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "78 rpm") records collected in a bound book resembling a photo album. This format evolved after 1948 into longer records played at 33+1⁄3 [rpm](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Giri_al_minuto?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Revolutions per minute") and later called [long playing](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Long_Playing?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Long Playing") . Commonly, an album, taken in the sense of a " [studio album](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_in_studio?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Studio album") " and not just a collection of recordings, differs from an [EP](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Extended_play?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Extended play") in that it is longer than 25 minutes and has more than 6 tracks. [[ 1 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-ukcs-1)[[ 2 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-ukca-2)

[![Image 3](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/ce/Discos_de_vinilo.jpg/330px-Discos_de_vinilo.jpg?utm_source=it.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/File:Discos_de_vinilo.jpg?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en)

 Several albums on display in a record store. 

**This entry or section on the subject of record albums [does not cite the necessary sources](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Wikipedia:Uso_delle_fonti?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Wikipedia:Use of sources") or those present are insufficient** . 

* * *

You can [improve this entry](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/w/index.php?title=Album_discografico&action=edit&_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en) by adding citations from [reliable sources](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Wikipedia:Fonti_attendibili?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Wikipedia:Reliable sources") according to the [guidelines on the use of sources](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Wikipedia:Uso_delle_fonti?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Wikipedia:Use of sources") . Follow the suggestions in the [reference project](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Progetto:Popular_music?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Project: Popular music") . 

The album was the dominant form of expression and consumption of recorded music from the late 1960s to the early 21st century, so much so that in the music world this period came to be known as _the album era_ . [[ 3 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-3) Vinyl LPs are still pressed today, although album sales in the 21st century have focused primarily on CD and MP3 formats. 8-track tape (Stereo 8) was the first widely used tape format alongside vinyl from 1965 until it was phased out in 1983, being gradually supplanted by cassette tape in the 1970s and early 1980s; the cassette's popularity peaked in the late 1980s before declining sharply in sales in the 1990s. Apart from a limited circle of enthusiasts, the cassette disappeared by the first decade of the 2000s.

Most albums are recorded in a [studio](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Studio_di_registrazione?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Recording studio")[[ 4 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-4) , although albums may also be recorded in a concert hall, at home, in the field, or many other locations. The length of time for fully recording an album varies from a few hours to several years. This process usually requires several [takes](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Ripresa?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Recovery") with different parts recorded separately and then brought together or " [mixed](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Missaggio?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Mixing") " together. Recordings done in one take without [overdubs](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Sovraincisione?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Overdubbing") are called "live", even when done in a studio. Studios are built to absorb sound, eliminating [reverberation](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Riverbero?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Reverb") , and to assist in mixing different takes; other locations, such as concert halls and some "live rooms", have reverberation to create a "live" sound [[ 5 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-Philip_Newell_169%E2%80%93170-5) . Recordings, even live, may contain editing, sound effects, vocal adjustments, etc. With modern recording technology, performers can be recorded in separate rooms or at separate times while listening to the other parts using headphones [;](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Cuffie?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Headphones") with each part recorded to a [separate track](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Registrazione_multitraccia?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Multitrack recording") .

[Album covers](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Copertina_(musica)?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Cover (music)") and liner [notes](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Note_di_copertina?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Liner notes") are used for the analysis or description of recordings, [musical lyrics](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Lirica_musicale?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Musical lyric") , or [booklets .](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Libretto_(musica)?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Libretto (music)")[[ 6 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-Album_Cover_Art_Series-6)[[ 7 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-The_history_of_the_CD_-_The_'Jewel_Case'-7) Historically, the term "album" was applied to a collection of various items housed in book format. In musical usage, the word was used for collections of short pieces of printed music, in the early days of [popular music](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Popular_music?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Popular music") , in the early 19th century . [[ 8 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-Mendelssohn_And_Schumann-8) Later, collections of 78 rpm records were grouped into book-like albums. [[ 9 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-alancross.ca-9) (One side of a 78 rpm record could only hold about 3.5 minutes of sound.) When LP records were introduced, a collection of tracks or songs on a single disc was similarly called an "album"; the word was extended to other recording media such as compact disc, MiniDisc, compact audio cassette, 8-track tape, and digital albums as new formats were introduced . [[ 10 ]](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Album_discografico?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en#cite_note-About_Vinyl_Records-10)

*   [Czechoslovakian writer](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Scrittrice?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Writer") Katarína [Lazarová](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Cecoslovacchia?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Czechoslovakia")[achieved](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Katar%C3%ADna_Lazarov%C3%A1?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Katarína Lazarová") wide popularity with her [novel](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Romanzo?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Novel")_The Wasp's Nest_ .
*   [Pope Pius XII](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Papa_Pio_XII?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Pope Pius XII") abolishes all noble titles belonging to ecclesiastics (formerly secularized episcopal principalities).

### January

[edit](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/w/index.php?title=1953&action=edit&section=2&_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Edit the January section")

*   [January 13](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/13_gennaio?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "January 13th") – _[Pravda](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Pravda?\_x\_tr\_sl=it&\_x\_tr\_tl=en&\_x\_tr\_hl=en "Truth")_ makes public the " [doctors' conspiracy](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Complotto_dei_medici?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Doctors' conspiracy") ," according to which some Jewish doctors planned to poison Stalin.
*   [January 31](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/31_gennaio?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "January 31st") – [February 1](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/1%C2%BA_febbraio?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "February 1st") : [North Sea flooding](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Inondazione_causata_dal_Mare_del_Nord_nel_1953?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Flood caused by the North Sea in 1953") causes thousands of deaths in the [Netherlands](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Paesi_Bassi?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Netherlands") and [the United Kingdom](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Regno_Unito?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "United Kingdom") .

### February

[edit](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/w/index.php?title=1953&action=edit&section=3&_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Edit the February section")

*   [February 10](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/10_febbraio?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "February 10th") – Law no. 136, establishing the [National Hydrocarbons Agency (ENI)](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Eni?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Eni") , is approved by [Parliament by a large majority.](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Parlamento_della_Repubblica_Italiana?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Parliament of the Italian Republic")[](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Eni?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Eni")
*   [February 11](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/11_febbraio?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "February 11th") – As a result of the "doctors' plot," [Israel](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Israele?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Israel") breaks off diplomatic relations with the [Soviet Union](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Unione_Sovietica?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Soviet Union") (resumes on July 6).
*   [February 14](https://it-wikipedia-org.translate.goog/wiki/Eclissi_solare_del_14_febbraio_1953?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en "Solar eclipse of February 14, 1953") : Solar eclipse

Personal name component indicating nobility

A **nobiliary particle** is a type of **onomastic particle** used in a [surname](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surname "Surname") or family name in many [Western cultures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Western_culture "Western culture") to signal the [nobility](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobility "Nobility") of a family. The [particle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grammatical_particle "Grammatical particle") used varies depending on the country, language and period of time. In some languages, it is the same as a regular [prepositional particle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Preposition_and_postposition "Preposition and postposition") that was used in the [creation of many surnames](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surname#History "Surname"). In some countries, it became customary to distinguish the nobiliary particle from the regular one by a different spelling, although in other countries these conventions did not arise, occasionally resulting in ambiguity. The nobiliary particle can often be omitted in everyday speech or certain contexts.

## Denmark and Norway

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nobiliary_particle&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Denmark and Norway")]

See also: [Danish nobility](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danish_nobility "Danish nobility") and [Norwegian nobility](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norwegian_nobility "Norwegian nobility")

[![Image 4](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/51/G%C3%B6rvel_Fadersdotter_%28Sparre%29_%281517-1605%29.jpg/250px-G%C3%B6rvel_Fadersdotter_%28Sparre%29_%281517-1605%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:G%C3%B6rvel_Fadersdotter_(Sparre)_(1517-1605).jpg)

[Gørvel Fadersdotter of Giske](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%B6rvel_Fadersdotter_(Sparre) "Görvel Fadersdotter (Sparre)") (1517–1605). In the painting: 'Fru Gørvel Fadersdatter til Giedske'

In [Denmark](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Denmark "Denmark") and [Norway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norway "Norway"), there is a distinction between (1) nobiliary particles in family names and (2) prepositions denoting an individual person's place of residence.

Nobiliary particles like **af**, **von**, and **de** (English: _of_) are integrated parts of family names. The use of particles was not a particular privilege for the nobility. On the other hand, particles were almost exclusively used by and associated with them. Especially in the late 17th and 18th centuries, a person would often receive a particle along with his or her old or new family name when ennobled. Examples are families like [de Gyldenpalm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gyldenpalm_(noble_family) "Gyldenpalm (noble family)") (lit. 'of Goldenpalm') and [von Munthe af Morgenstierne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Munthe_af_Morgenstierne_(noble_family) "Munthe af Morgenstierne (noble family)") (lit. 'of Munthe of Morningstar'). Otherwise, particles would arrive together with immigrants. Examples are families like [von Ahnen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Preben_von_Ahnen "Preben von Ahnen"). Prominent non-noble families having used particles are [von Cappelen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cappelen_(family) "Cappelen (family)"), [von der Lippe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Von_der_Lippe_(Norwegian_family) "Von der Lippe (Norwegian family)"), and [de Créqui dit la Roche](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cr%C3%A9quy_family "Créquy family").

The preposition _til_ (English: _to_, but translates as _of_; comparable with German _zu_) is placed behind a person's full name in order to denote his or her place of residence, for example [Sigurd Jonsson til Sudreim](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sigurd_Jonsson "Sigurd Jonsson").

## France

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nobiliary_particle&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: France")]

See also: [French nobility](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_nobility "French nobility")

In [France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/France "France")—and in [England](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/England "England"), largely as a result of the [Norman Conquest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norman_Conquest "Norman Conquest")—the particle **de** precedes a _nom de terre_ ('name of land') in many families of the French nobility: for example, [Maximilien de Béthune](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maximilien_de_B%C3%A9thune,_Duke_of_Sully "Maximilien de Béthune, Duke of Sully").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobiliary_particle#cite_note-1) A few do not have this particle: for example, [Pierre Séguier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pierre_S%C3%A9guier "Pierre Séguier"), [Lord Chancellor of France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lord_Chancellor_of_France "Lord Chancellor of France"). The particle can also be **du** ('of the' in the masculine form, analogous to _de la_ in the feminine), **d'** (used, per the rules of [orthography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elision_(French) "Elision (French)"), when the _nom de terre_ begins with a vowel; for example, [Ferdinand d'Orléans](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prince_Ferdinand_Philippe,_Duke_of_Orl%C3%A9ans "Prince Ferdinand Philippe, Duke of Orléans")), or **des** ('of the' in the plural). In French, _de_ indicates a link between the land and a person—either [landlord](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Landlord "Landlord") or [peasant](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peasant "Peasant").

The nobleman was always designated _escuyer_, for '[squire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Squire "Squire")' in English form (_dapifer_ in Latin), or _chevalier_ for '[knight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knight "Knight")' (_equites_ in Latin). Only knights were designated by the spoken style _monseigneur_ or _messire_ for '[sir](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sir "Sir")' (_dominus_ in Latin), as, for example, "monseigneur [Bertrand du Guesclin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bertrand_du_Guesclin "Bertrand du Guesclin"), chevalier"—in English form, "Sir Bertrand du Guesclin, knight".

By convention, surnames with the non-noble use of the particle _de_ are spelled as a single word (e.g., "[Pierre Dupont](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pierre_Dupont "Pierre Dupont")"),[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobiliary_particle#cite_note-2) though many such surnames conserved the _de_ as a separate word.

Since the sixteenth century, surnames among the French nobility have often been composed of a combination of [patronymic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patronymic "Patronymic") names, titles, or _noms de terres_ ('names of lands' or estates) joined by the preposition _de_, as in "[Charles Maurice de Talleyrand-Périgord](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Maurice_de_Talleyrand-P%C3%A9rigord "Charles Maurice de Talleyrand-Périgord")".[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobiliary_particle#cite_note-3) The use of this particle began to be an essential appearance of nobility. Following the end of the [Kingdom of France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_of_France "Kingdom of France"), however, the use of _de_ did not invariably denote nobility. In the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, some middle-class families simply adopted the particle without being ennobled; [Maximilien Robespierre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maximilien_Robespierre "Maximilien Robespierre")'s family, for example, used the particle for some generations.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobiliary_particle#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobiliary_particle#cite_note-5)

## Germany and Austria

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nobiliary_particle&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Germany and Austria")]

See also: [German nobility](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German_nobility "German nobility"), [von](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Von "Von"), and [Austrian nobility](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Austrian_nobility "Austrian nobility")

In [Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germany "Germany") and [Austria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Austria "Austria"), **von** (descending _from_) or **zu** (resident _at_) generally precedes the surname of a noble family (in, for example, the names of [Alexander von Humboldt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_von_Humboldt "Alexander von Humboldt") and [Gottfried Heinrich Graf zu Pappenheim](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gottfried_Heinrich_Graf_zu_Pappenheim "Gottfried Heinrich Graf zu Pappenheim")). If it is justified, they can be used together (_von und zu_): the ruler of Liechtenstein as of 2022, for example, is [Johannes Adam Ferdinand Alois Josef Maria Marko d'Aviano Pius von und zu Liechtenstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hans-Adam_II,_Prince_of_Liechtenstein "Hans-Adam II, Prince of Liechtenstein").

In some cases – although unusually, and perhaps introduced to distinguish collateral branches of the same family – these more common particles might be supplemented with **auf** (i.e., residing at yet another place different from the one _zu_ refers to and meaning _[up]on_ in English): _Von A-dynasty/place, zu B-town, auf C-ville/location/residence_. Rarer variants are "von der", "von dem", "zum", "zur", etc.

As in France and Spain, not all noble families use a nobiliary particle. The names of the most ancient nobility, the _[Uradel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uradel "Uradel")_, but also names of some old untitled nobility, often do not contain either _von_ or _zu_, such as _Grote_, _Knigge_ or _Vincke_.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobiliary_particle#cite_note-Nichtadeliges-6) Conversely, the prefix _von_ occurs in the names of 200 to 300 non-noble families,[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobiliary_particle#cite_note-Adelszeichen-7) much like _van_ in the Netherlands.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

(Redirected from [Style (manner of address)](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Style_(manner_of_address)&redirect=no "Style (manner of address)"))

Official or legally recognized title for a person or entity

![Image 4](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/b/b4/Ambox_important.svg/40px-Ambox_important.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)**This article has multiple issues.** Please help **[improve it](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:EditPage/Style_(form_of_address) "Special:EditPage/Style (form of address)")** or discuss these issues on the **[talk page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Style_(form_of_address) "Talk:Style (form of address)")**. _([Learn how and when to remove these messages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Maintenance\_template\_removal "Help:Maintenance template removal"))_ ![Image 5](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2e/Ambox_contradict.svg/40px-Ambox_contradict.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)This article **appears to contradict the article _[Royal and noble styles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal\_and\_noble\_styles "Royal and noble styles")_**. Please discuss at the [talk page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Style_(form_of_address) "Talk:Style (form of address)") and do not remove this message until the contradictions are resolved._(June 2013)_ [![Image 6: icon](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/9/99/Question_book-new.svg/60px-Question_book-new.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Question_book-new.svg)This article **needs [more citations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Verifiability "Wikipedia:Verifiability")**. Please help [improve this article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:EditPage/Style_(form_of_address) "Special:EditPage/Style (form of address)") by [adding citations to reliable sources](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Referencing_for_beginners "Help:Referencing for beginners"). Unsourced material may be challenged and [removed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Verifiability#Burden_of_evidence "Wikipedia:Verifiability"). _Find sources:_["Style"form of address](https://www.google.com/search?as_eq=wikipedia&q=%22Style%22+form+of+address)–[news](https://www.google.com/search?tbm=nws&q=%22Style%22+form+of+address+-wikipedia&tbs=ar:1)**·**[newspapers](https://www.google.com/search?&q=%22Style%22+form+of+address&tbs=bkt:s&tbm=bks)**·**[books](https://www.google.com/search?tbs=bks:1&q=%22Style%22+form+of+address+-wikipedia)**·**[scholar](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Style%22+form+of+address)**·**[JSTOR](https://www.jstor.org/action/doBasicSearch?Query=%22Style%22+form+of+address&acc=on&wc=on)_(June 2008)_ _([Learn how and when to remove this message](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Maintenance\_template\_removal "Help:Maintenance template removal"))_ _([Learn how and when to remove this message](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Maintenance\_template\_removal "Help:Maintenance template removal"))_

A **style of office**, also called **manner of reference**, or **form of address** when someone is spoken to directly, is an official or legally recognized form of reference for a person or other entity (such as a government or company), and may often be used in conjunction with a personal [title](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Title "Title").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Style_(manner_of_address)#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Style_(manner_of_address)#cite_note-2) A style, by [tradition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tradition "Tradition") or [law](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Law "Law"), precedes a reference to a person who holds a post or [political office](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Political_office "Political office") and is sometimes used to refer to the office itself. An [honorific](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Honorific "Honorific") can also be awarded to an individual in a personal capacity. Such styles are particularly associated with [monarchies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monarchy "Monarchy"), where they may be used by a wife of an office holder or of a prince of the blood, for the duration of their [marriage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marriage "Marriage"). They are also almost universally used for [presidents](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_(government_title) "President (government title)") in [republics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republic "Republic") and in many countries for [members](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Legislator "Legislator") of [legislative bodies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Legislature "Legislature"), higher-ranking [judges](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Judge "Judge"), and senior constitutional office holders. [Religious leaders](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Religious_leader "Religious leader") also have styles.

The second-person (singular and plural) possessive adjective _your_ is used as a form of address (that is, when speaking directly to the person[s] entitled to the style[s]); the third-person possessive adjectives _his/her_ (singular) and _their_ (plural) are used as forms of reference (that is, when speaking about the person[s] entitled to the style[s]).
